Interface CardVisitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
CanDrawVisitor, DrawCardVisitor, PlayEventVisitor
public interface CardVisitor
Visitor interface for the three main card types in the game.

Implementations override only the visit overloads relevant to them; the remaining overloads are no-ops by default, so implementors are not forced to handle card types they do not care about.
